name: perchlight-forms
description: A free, self-hosted form backend for static sites on Cloudflare Workers + D1 (+ R2 for uploads): plain HTML or fetch, spam folder, email and webhook notifications, exports.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters), e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Protects the admin API (/api/*): reading, exporting and deleting submissions.

IP_SALT.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters). Keys the rate limit's daily hash, so no IP address is ever stored. Forms answer 503 until it's set.

LINK_SECRET.description: Required for file uploads. A long random string (16+ characters). Signs the expiring download links for attachments.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. Your Turnstile secret key (dashboard > Turnstile), for forms with "turnstile": true. Leave empty otherwise.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. Signs JSON webhooks (X-Perchlight-Signature). Needed only if a form sends to a JSON webhook.
